comment: C12 provider registry seed (task 269). Single source of truth for the built-in provider definitions: the Rust registry loads this file (include_str!), and migration 000127 seeds the provider_registry_definitions table from it (generated SQL, see docs/integration/INTEGRATION_NOTES_C12.md). Admin-added providers live in the table / config document, never in this file. Capabilities keys differ per family; see unified_core::provider_registry for the per-family reading rules.
